note: The case rests on two items. Item 0 is the first full quarter of HEMANGEOL, which the company's own Q2 10-Q arithmetic puts above the $42.2M bar. Item 1 is a name that has raised guidance at every print and whose raises have been bought, now going in 26% off its high and call-heavy. The LIBERVANT upfront hitting the margin guide (item 2) pulls the other way.

The negative is item 0: a ramp-down of a major client project, with 71% of revenue in two customers, threatening the 40%+ guide at the new CEO's first guide, on a name that sells reaffirmations. It is partly offset by the $67M customer advance in the 10-Q supporting Q3 (item 1) and by a 13% short in a stock that has already fallen 38%.

Q4 is effectively pre-announced, so the move sits on the first FY27 guide. Item 2 says negative comps and lower pricing make the +17.8% revenue consensus hard to meet, and the last first-guide print fell 11%. A ~25%-of-float short, the margin path and the Yoshi/loyalty launches shrink that negative.

The two sides offset. A conservative Q3 AOI guide sets up a likely beat-and-raise (item 0) and buyback execution near the lows could surprise (item 4). Against that, the stock has rallied 47% off its lows on no news (item 6), with weaker read-throughs on the Lemonade loss ratio and IDEXX visits, so it nets slightly negative.

Near balanced. The likely Q3 revenue miss against a disputed bar and the CB-4 slip risk (items 0-1) are already met by bid puts and a 60% drawdown. A rising 33%-of-float short at a capitulation low (item 4), a headline GAAP beat from the warrant gain (item 2) and a chance for the call to defuse the Google-backstop financing fear (item 3) tilt it slightly up.
